note: The thresholds the Outreach Preflight uses. Change a number and re-run. These are common practitioner guidance for cold outreach, not laws, except where a line says so. Nothing here is legal advice.
optout_rx: unsubscribe|opt[- ]?out|reply (no|stop)|(just )?say (no|stop)|not (relevant|for you|interested).{0,60}(let me know|reply|tell me)|(prefer|rather) not to (hear|receive|get)|won't (write|email|message|contact)|will not (write|email|message|contact)|no hard feelings|take you off|remove you
mailbox_daily_note: Cold email from one mailbox is usually kept to a few dozen a day, and a new domain or mailbox is warmed up slowly. About 30 a day per mailbox matches the Outreach Stack's own limit; your own engine cap is also checked.
sender_guidelines: Google's Email sender guidelines (support.google.com/a/answer/81126) ask every sender to authenticate with SPF and DKIM, and bulk senders with DMARC as well.
